messages:
toni (Design): small design review: updating Compliance > Encryption region picker to show which regions use Redwood-managed keys vs customer KMS (BYOK). attaching tiny mock. need copy + a11y + keyboard notes.

mohit (Product): good. ensure account default region is preselected but editable. expand BYOK to 'bring your own key' inline where helpful.

kevin (Eng): implementation: custom combobox on modern browsers, native select fallback otherwise. use aria-activedescendant on options and aria-describedby referencing helper copy. add aria-live polite status announcing selection changes.

samir (Security): prefer explicit labels: "Redwood-managed key (AES-256)" and "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK)". replace any "key id" text with "key reference". helper copy should say audit logs include region + key reference when BYOK is used.

allegra (PM): UX: if tenant hasn't set up BYOK, show BYOK option disabled with tooltip: "Requires uploaded key and an IAM role - see docs." keep option visible but explain prerequisites.

toni (Design): plan: compact badges with icon+text (not color-only), helper row under control: "Audit logs record region and key reference when customer-managed keys are used." wire helper via aria-describedby and include a tiny "learn more" link.

a11y-bot: checklist: combobox role pattern, aria-activedescendant updates on arrow nav, aria-describedby present, focus outline visible, badge contrast >= 4.5:1. manual review flagged.

kevin (Eng): modal when switching to BYOK: title "Switch to customer-managed KMS (BYOK)", body "New requests will use this key. Audit logs will record the key reference. You must upload or grant access to a key to complete." add propagation note: "May take up to 2 minutes to propagate." set initial focus on primary action and trap focus.

samir (Security): testing: CI audits should assert a sample entry like: "action: inference.request, region: eu-west-1, key_reference: projects/..../keys/key-123 (customer-managed)" appears after change. also ensure disabled BYOK doesn't leak key_reference.

toni (Design): punchlist: update badge text to "Redwood-managed key" / "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK)", add helper copy (aria-describedby), disabled tooltip text, modal copy + propagation note, aria-live announcement. will push revised mock and a11y checklist to the ticket later today.
